# Zhenhua Liu

I am building this portfolio for **ISSS626 Geospatial Analytics and Applications**. It is both a coursework index and a record of how my spatial reasoning develops through the term.

The site deliberately keeps analysis close to presentation: R handles the reproducible work, Quarto turns the notebooks into a coherent website, GitHub records each revision, and Netlify serves the published result.

::: {.about-callout}

## How an exercise becomes a page

:::: {.process-grid}
<div><span>01</span><strong>Question</strong><p>Define the spatial problem and the decision the visual must support.</p></div>
<div><span>02</span><strong>Wrangle</strong><p>Inspect, transform, join, and validate data with reproducible R code.</p></div>
<div><span>03</span><strong>Visualise</strong><p>Choose encodings and cartographic hierarchy that fit the evidence.</p></div>
<div><span>04</span><strong>Reflect</strong><p>Document limitations, learning, and the next analytical move.</p></div>
::::
:::::
